method.graph: Pre-deletion training graph of each CPPR network: keeper.laundering.core load, full_graph and train_split with the dataset's tt (snapshots 0 to tt - 1). Active accounts have a training edge at either end.
method.legacy: keeper.analysis.defense_extra.tier_coverage (Task 2.2): seeds S0 (more positive than negative in-edges in snapshots 0 to 4), the endorsed set D of the one-pass endorsement, and the tier mix of keeper.credibility.tiers.legacy_bfs over the active accounts.
method.variants: Four variants per network (settings.variants), crossing the propagation and the eligibility guard. Propagation: uncapped, the approved BTP rule, or capped, in which every endorsement carries at most edge_cap = edge_cap_units * theta0 per step (ruling R37), the sender keeping the rest, with edge_cap_units = keeper.credibility.tiers.KEEPER_EDGE_CAP_UNITS = 2 (ruling R38: the smallest value in (1, 2, 4, 8) for which the honest-data eps rule holds on all three networks). Guard (ruling R56, neg_from): the negative in-edges counted against eligibility come from trusted raters only ('trusted', the credible-negatives guard) or from every rater ('all', the rule of Task 3.1). capped with 'trusted' is KEEPER's default; uncapped, capped_neg_all and uncapped_neg_all (Task 3.1's approved rule) are the ablations. Every block under variants is computed for that variant alone.
method.choose_eps: keeper.credibility.tiers.choose_eps with the variant's edge_cap_units and neg_from: for each eps in settings.eps_grid, btp_tiers on the training graph; retention is the share of the legacy Tier >= 1 accounts that BTP keeps in Tier >= 1. eps is the largest value with retention >= settings.keep (met). If no value qualifies, the values of settings.eps_grid_extended are added (extended true). If none qualifies, the smallest value evaluated (met false). Honest data only; no attack data enters the choice.
method.calibration: Ruling R32: keeper.credibility.tiers.calibrate_btp on the training graph at the chosen eps freezes the seeds S0 (snapshots <= t_seed), K = ceil(log2 n_ref), theta0 = eps / n_ref (n_ref = the training graph's active accounts) and edge_cap = edge_cap_units * theta0. Every attacked graph below uses these values unchanged.
method.btp: keeper.credibility.tiers.btp_tiers with the frozen calibration on the training graph (identical to calibrating on it): trust starts at 1/|S0| on each seed and spreads for K steps over the endorsement graph (pairs whose last rating is positive); each step an account sends half its trust, split equally over its endorsees (each endorsement capped at edge_cap in the capped variants), and keeps the rest; an account without endorsees keeps all. Endorsed: trust >= theta0 and positive in-edges from trusted raters outnumber the negative in-edges from trusted raters (neg_from 'trusted') or from every rater ('all'); rating edges, repeats included. Tiers 1 to 3: terciles of trust over the endorsed accounts (tie rule of legacy_levels). Tier mix over the active accounts.
method.overlap: Legacy (legacy_bfs) and BTP Tier >= 1 sets of the same graph; retention = n_both / n_legacy_tier1.
method.causal: keeper.credibility.tiers.calibrate_btp_causal (row t calibrated on the training edges of snapshots < t: K(t), theta0(t) = eps / n_ref(t), seeds, edge_cap(t) = edge_cap_units * theta0(t)) and causal_tiers with that calibration, T = tt rows. tier1_counts[t] counts the Tier >= 1 accounts of row t; theta0 of the empty row 0 is infinite (stored as null).
method.sybil_test: s fakes (new accounts n..n+s-1) and g attack edges, all positive and in the last training snapshot, appended after the honest edges with the attack edges first. ring: attack edge a reaches fake a mod s, and fake_j endorses fake_(j+1 mod s). star: every attack edge reaches the hub fake_0, which endorses every other fake. random: settings.ring_draws draws (default_rng(settings.ring_seed)) of max(ring_g) distinct accounts from the pool, the honest accounts in the legacy endorsed set D whose legacy tier and the variant's BTP tier are both >= 2. max_trust (ruling R33b): the max(ring_g) honest accounts with the largest B(u) = sum_{i<K} min(0.5 t_i(u) / (dout(u) + 1), edge_cap) over the honest iterates of the variant's frozen calibration (keeper.credibility.tiers.endorser_inflow_scores; edge_cap infinite uncapped; ties to the smaller id), recorded with B(u) and B(u) / theta0 under endorsers. A case with g attack edges uses the first g endorsers of its set. Every case applies the variant's frozen calibration and guard (the fakes receive no negative rating, so the guard changes their admission only through the variant's eps and the random pool). legacy_admitted and btp_admitted count fakes in Tier >= 1 under legacy_bfs and btp_tiers, and *_per_edge divides them by g; btp_trusted counts fakes with trust >= theta0; sybil_trust is the fakes' total trust; bound = keeper.credibility.tiers.bound_sybil_trust over the iteration history of the attacked graph (seeds, K and edge_cap of the calibration; each term min(0.5 t_i(u_a) / dout(u_a), edge_cap) when capped); cap = floor(bound / theta0 + settings.cap_tol) and cap_per_edge = cap / g; cap_constant = floor(K g edge_cap_units + settings.cap_tol) for the capped variants (null uncapped); bound_holds: sybil_trust <= bound + settings.bound_tol; cap_holds: btp_admitted <= cap; cap_constant_holds: cap <= cap_constant. In the summary, limited_by_region_size marks rows whose largest admission equals s, a lower bound. uncalibrated_cap_growth: the first max_trust endorser, ring, g = 1, with btp_tiers recalibrated on each attacked graph (calibration=None, at the chosen eps and the variant's edge_cap_units), so theta0 and K count the fakes.
method.star_size_probe: Every variant, under its frozen calibration and guard, without the legacy pass: one attack edge from each of the PROBE_ENDORSERS = 5 accounts with the largest B(u) (ruling R33b) into the hub of a star of s fakes, for every s from 2 to floor(K edge_cap_units) + 4 (capped; best sizes exact for stars) or for s in PROBE_SIZES_UNCAPPED (uncapped). per_endorser gives each endorser's best star (best_s, max_admitted; smallest s on ties) and lower_bound, true when that star was admitted whole and size best_s + 1 was not probed; max_admitted, argmax_endorser, argmax_s and lower_bound summarise the best endorser.
method.cap_sensitivity: A sensitivity analysis of the cap size, keyed by guard (neg_from): 'all' is the evidence of ruling R38, and 'trusted' repeats it under the guard of ruling R56. For each edge_cap_units in settings.cap_sensitivity_units, keeper.credibility.tiers.choose_eps rows over settings.eps_sensitivity_grid (retention with that cap), the eps the preregistered rule picks (rule_eps: settings.eps_grid, extended to settings.eps_grid_extended if no value qualifies; rule_met, rule_extended) and per_edge_constant = floor(K edge_cap_units), K of the training graph: the most fakes one attack edge can bring into Tier >= 1.
method.guard_change: Ruling R56, honest data: for each cap (uncapped, capped), the guarded variant's tiers against the all-raters variant's, each at its own eps under its calibration frozen on the training graph (same_eps tells whether the two eps agree). n_union counts the accounts in Tier >= 1 under either; n_trusted_only and n_all_only those in Tier >= 1 under one guard only; n_tier_changed those of the union whose tier differs; share_tier_changed = n_tier_changed / n_union and share_tier1_membership_changed = (n_trusted_only + n_all_only) / n_union. transitions[a][b] counts the active accounts in tier a under 'all' and tier b under 'trusted'.
method.demotion_census: Ruling R56, no training, keyed by victim pool (settings.census_pools). Methods: legacy_bfs (which counts every rater's negative ratings, neg_from 'all') and every variant, each under its calibration frozen on the training graph at its own eps. Per method, settings.census_victims victims are drawn without replacement (default_rng(settings.census_seed)) from its own Tier >= 2 accounts (pool 'own': the share of the accounts it deems credible that free Sybils demote) or from the accounts in Tier >= 2 under every method (pool 'common': the same victims for every method, a paired comparison); n_pool counts the candidates. For each k in settings.census_k and each victim, one attacked stream: k fresh Sybils (accounts n .. n + k - 1, no attack edge) each rate the victim negatively once, appended after the honest edges in the last training snapshot; tiers are recomputed on that stream with the frozen calibration. Per method and k: n_dropped (victims whose tier drops) and share_dropped, n_to_tier0 (victims in Tier 0 afterwards) and share_to_tier0, collateral_total and collateral_max (other honest accounts whose tier moves, summed and maximised over the streams), n_streams_with_collateral, and n_streams_changed (streams in which any honest tier moves). unchanged: no honest tier moved in any stream; it must hold under 'trusted' (the property of keeper.credibility.tiers, ruling R56).
method.calibration_table: One row per network and variant, taken from the blocks under networks: the frozen calibration (eps, K, n_ref, theta0, edge_cap, n_seeds), the eps rule's outcome (met, extended, retention, n_tier1), guarantee_per_edge = floor(K edge_cap_units) (null uncapped), best_star = the star-size probe's max_admitted (best_star_lower_bound for the sparse uncapped probe), and, for the guarded variants, share_tier_changed_vs_all and share_tier1_membership_changed_vs_all from guard_change. The preregistration takes its numbers from this table.
method.runtime_s: Wall-clock seconds (time.perf_counter) on provenance.host, one process, CPU: btp_tiers on the training graph, calibrate_btp_causal over the T prefixes, and causal_tiers over its T rows with that calibration. Not deterministic.
